main.AGENTS.md:
# Ledger App agent guidance

Ledger App is the customer billing portal: invoices, plans, and account settings.

- Run `pnpm test` before opening a pull request.
- Code under `app/billing/` and `db/migrations/` moves money or stored data. Treat it as sensitive.
- Customer-facing views live in `app/views/`.

398.title: Tidy settings nav spacing
398.body:
## Problem

The settings nav items sit too close together on narrow screens.

## Scope

Increase the gap between settings nav items by one step.

## Verification

- The settings nav uses the `gap-3` spacing class.
- Existing settings tests pass.

Scores: impact 1, confidence 3, verification effort 1, undo cost 1.
